title: Planning a weekend together
objective: Proposer une activité, exprimer une préférence, négocier un programme et justifier un choix.
model_text: A: What shall we do on Saturday? B: We could visit the park. A: I'd rather go to the cinema because it's raining. B: How about the museum? A: That's a good idea! Let's meet at two.

steps.title: Diagnostic en binômes
steps.student_instruction: Suggest one activity for Saturday and answer your partner.

steps.title: Comprendre un dialogue modèle
steps.student_instruction: Read the dialogue. Underline two suggestions and circle the final agreement.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Lire le dialogue à deux voix; faire repérer suggestion et accord.

steps.title: Structures utiles
steps.student_instruction: Match each expression with suggest, prefer, agree or disagree.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Modéliser could + base verbale et How about + -ing.

steps.title: Entraînement A/B/C
steps.student_instruction: Complete the activity for your track.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Distribuer les trois niveaux; proposer aides à la demande.

steps.title: Préparation en binômes
steps.student_instruction: Plan a weekend with a partner; agree on two activities.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Exiger deux propositions, une préférence et une justification.

steps.title: Jeux de rôle simultanés
steps.student_instruction: Act out your conversation, then change one constraint.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Observer plusieurs binômes; recueillir une trace courte pour les autres.

steps.title: Retour collectif
steps.student_instruction: Correct the three most common errors.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write one suggestion and one polite response.

sheets.student_content: Complete: We could ___ (visit) the park. How about ___ (go) swimming? I'd rather ___ (watch) a film. Then use the dialogue frame to agree on one activity.
sheets.facilitator_correction: visit; going; watch. Accepter plusieurs activités si cohérentes.

sheets.student_content: With a partner, plan two Saturday activities. Make three suggestions, express one preference and give a reason. Write a six-line dialogue.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Réponse ouverte; vérifier propositions, préférence, justification et accord final.

sheets.student_content: Plan a weekend for two friends with different budgets and weather preferences. Negotiate two activities, offer an alternative and justify your final decision.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Réponse ouverte; vérifier négociation, contraintes prises en compte, reformulations et accord.

criteria: Propose au moins une activité intelligible
Exprime une préférence et une raison

common_errors.remediation: Après could, utiliser la base verbale sans to.
I prefer to go / I prefer going.
